passkeys.browser.get: Use the browser or a security key
passkeys.browser.help: The browser asks for Windows Hello, Touch ID, your phone or a security key. On a Mac, a passkey provider has to be turned on in System Settings first.
passkeys.claims.label: Written by the website, not checked by Ferret
passkeys.claims.name: The website calls itself
passkeys.done.added: The passkey is added to the item.
passkeys.done.created: The passkey is saved in Ferret.
passkeys.done.never: Ferret will not offer passkeys on this site. Handing over to the browser…
passkeys.error.already_exists: Ferret already has a passkey for this account here.
passkeys.error.busy: Ferret is busy. Try again in a moment.
passkeys.error.disconnected: Ferret could not be reached. Close this window and try again.
passkeys.error.excluded: This website says you already have a passkey for this account. Use the browser instead, or choose the passkey you have.
passkeys.error.internal_error: Something went wrong in Ferret. Nothing was changed.
passkeys.error.invalid_input: That choice did not work. Nothing was changed.
passkeys.error.network: There is no contact with the server. Ferret cannot save a new passkey now.
passkeys.error.not_allowed: Ferret cannot use a passkey for this website here.
passkeys.error.not_available: Passkeys are turned off in Ferret.
passkeys.error.not_found: That item is no longer there. Choose again.
passkeys.error.not_verified: Ferret could not check that it is you. Nothing was done.
passkeys.error.request_gone: The website is no longer waiting for this passkey.
passkeys.error.security_error: This website asked for a passkey for an address it may not use. The request was stopped.
passkeys.error.site_refused: Ferret cannot use a passkey for this website. The request was stopped.
passkeys.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
passkeys.error.verification_needed: Ferret has to check that it is you first.
passkeys.error.worker_failed: Ferret could not do that. Nothing was changed.
passkeys.foreign: Another password manager or the site itself also handles passkeys on this page. Turn off the passkey feature in it, or use it. The browser here means whatever was there first.
passkeys.get.none: No Ferret passkey for this website
passkeys.get.none_help: Your passkey may be in the browser, on your phone or on a security key. The website cannot tell that Ferret has none.
passkeys.gone: This request has ended. The window closes.
passkeys.lead.get: The website asks you to sign in with a passkey.
passkeys.lead.make: The website asks you to create a passkey.
passkeys.locked.lead: Unlock Ferret to answer. Your passkeys stay in your vault.
passkeys.make.attach: Add to an item you have
passkeys.make.attach_hint: Only items for this website that have no passkey are listed.
passkeys.make.existing: You already have a Ferret passkey for this account in {item}. It works until you delete it. A new item makes a second one.
passkeys.make.name: Item name
passkeys.make.offline: Ferret cannot save a new passkey without contact with the server. You can use the browser instead.
passkeys.never.help: Ferret will leave passkeys on this site to the browser. You can change that in the settings.
passkeys.others.label: Or
passkeys.site.label: Website
passkeys.site.rp_id: Passkeys for this website are tied to
passkeys.site.unknown: Ferret shows the website once it is unlocked.
passkeys.verify.recent: Ferret was unlocked a moment ago, so one click is enough.
